detailed_description:
The target video is in a live-action, cinematic historical-drama style with a cold, desaturated blue-grey palette under heavy overcast lighting.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot frames the Huazhou government office gate beneath storm clouds: an imperial envoy's procession stands on the stone steps, two rows of guards with long staffs line the passage on both sides, a bright yellow imperial edict is unrolled as a deep official voice (S1) proclaims it aloud from the steps, the exact words blurred by wind and distance, and kneeling civilians form a dark silhouette band across the foreground. The edict is slowly rolled up at the end of the shot.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera cuts to a slightly high medium shot: <Subject 1> kneels at the foot of the steps, back perfectly straight. A guard steps forward and strips the official seal from his waist while another pulls off his outer robe and drops it on the stone; the seal lands with a heavy muffled thud. <Subject 1> remains kneeling, unmoved.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a high-angle close-up: a rough wooden cangue is clamped onto <Subject 1>'s shoulders, the lock snapping shut with a sharp crack that carries a faint echo.
[Shot 4] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a close-up outside the wall of guards: <Subject 2> rises on his toes to see over the guards' shoulders, his face draining of color, both hands clutching the garment of the man in front of him while the crowd's murmur stops dead.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to a shaky handheld medium shot: <Subject 2> shoves forward wildly until two long spears cross to bar his chest, his palms pressing hard against the shafts. <Subject 2> (S2) screams desperately: <d>[Chinese] 他到底犯了什么罪？！你们说他到底犯了什么罪！</d> The crowd behind him surges against the guards.
[Shot 6] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle close-up: the escorting official on the steps slowly turns and looks down from above, a faint pitying sneer forming on his lips as wind snaps the banners behind him.

overall_soundscape: Wind drags across the stone plaza beneath a low rumble of distant thunder. The muffled thud of the seal hitting stone, the sharp crack of the cangue lock, choked gasps from the crowd, and the escort's synchronized footsteps layer over the fading proclamation.
